title: MA2H Session (v0.5)
description: A Hub-registered, lease-bound, ephemeral addressing scope under one agent.id (spec §16). The root is the session RESOURCE as the Hub returns it (POST /v1/sessions 201; GET /v1/sessions[/{id}]). A session id is Hub-minted (`^sess_`), is not a secret and not a credential; the session locates one live invocation while the principal (the agent.id + its credential) authenticates and is accountable. $defs carry the register-request and response wrapper shapes.

id.description: Hub-minted session id (spec §16). Not a secret; another principal's session id MUST be indistinguishable from unknown.

agent_id.description: The owning principal. Registration is rejected for an agent.id containing `#` (the address separator, spec §4).

state.description: active -> closed (explicit DELETE, idempotent) or active -> expired (lease lapse, Hub clock). Both terminal and immutable (first-terminal-wins, spec §16); terminal sessions remain readable for the advertised retention window.

expires_at.description: Current lease expiry (Hub clock). Renewed only by client-originated authenticated activity that references the session (spec §16); a merely-open connection is NOT renewal evidence.

last_seen.description: The session's latest client-originated renewal event (spec §15.1 per-session presence). Optional: absent until first derivable, and exposed under exactly the visibility rules that gate the read itself (spec §16.4).

ttl_seconds.description: The lease TTL in effect (the requested value, clamped to the advertised sessions.max_ttl_seconds).

closed_at.description: When the session reached a terminal state.

run_id.description: The invocation's run_id as supplied at registration (audit label; still non-authorizing, spec §9.1).

project.description: Optional grouping key, as on the §4.1 agent descriptor.

registerRequest.title: POST /v1/sessions request
registerRequest.description: All fields optional (spec §16). ttl_seconds is a request the Hub MAY clamp to advertised bounds.
